PSX Memory Test - Analogue Pocket (openFPGA)

Phase 3 of the PSX-on-Pocket roadmap. No PSX logic: it exercises the Pocket's SDRAM, the two PSRAM
chips (ganged as one 32-bit RAM) and the SRAM, verifies every access, and prints the measured MB/s,
ns per access and error counts on screen. Setup, screen layout and gate criteria: docs/pocket/MEMTEST.md
in the PSX_MiSTer repository.

Copy this folder's Cores/, Platforms/ and Assets/ to the root of the Pocket SD card.
